_contract: program/one-system 06_pipelines. Each stage becomes one Paperclip mission for its builder, judged by its judge. A stage with gate 'owner' waits for the owner to advance the run (for example: the client paid). Permissions outside the unattended set park the mission for owner authorization (publishing, sending, spending).

found-first-launch.label: Found First: scorecard to Launch handoff

stages.name: scorecard
stages.done_means: Lead-Leak Scorecard with lost-revenue math in the prospect's numbers, checked against the live site

stages.name: pricing
stages.done_means: price and terms for this prospect from the offer ladder

stages.name: outreach-draft
stages.done_means: outreach message and call plan drafted; the owner sends it

stages.name: intake
stages.done_means: client-intake answers saved to the client's Found First project

stages.name: lead-path
stages.done_means: request form saves every inquiry and alerts the owner's phone; one live test inquiry received

stages.name: technical-fixes
stages.done_means: indexing, titles, descriptions, speed basics and business structured data fixed on a preview

stages.name: answer-pages
stages.done_means: up to 5 service-and-area pages and an FAQ from real customer questions, drafted for approval

stages.name: first-month-posts
stages.done_means: 8 to 12 posts with images drafted for approval

stages.name: handoff
stages.done_means: signed checklist, lead list and scorecard handed to the client; second payment requested by the owner

software-product.label: Software factory: one product slice to an owner-approved release

stages.name: build
stages.done_means: spec, branch with passing tests, independent PASS on the exact commit, preview link

stages.name: release
stages.done_means: owner-approved production release with rollback written
